title: workbench evolution persona roster (.workbench/evolution/personas.json)
description: Project-configurable persona panel for /workbench:evolve summits. Flat object: scalar knobs plus one 'personas' array of flat objects (string values only) — the shape scripts/evolve.sh's dependency-free parser understands. Exactly one persona must have role 'critic'. All constraints here (types, exactly-one-critic, and the caps on panel size / prompt length / retro_slice) are enforced at runtime by `evolve.sh validate` — the schema alone gates nothing. Trust model: this file is checked-in project configuration — persona prompts are trusted the same as any other config (whoever can edit it already has repo write access), not attacker-controlled input.

description.description: Human-readable note about this panel (presets use it to say which tier/domain they fit).

cadence_hours.description: A summit is due when STRICTLY more than this many hours have passed since the last one, regardless of backlog depth (keeps the retrospective mandate from starving). Integer — evolve.sh's bash arithmetic rejects floats at validate time.

queue_low_water.description: A summit is due when the unblocked backlog (for the configured track) drops below this count — the 'keep 2-3 tasks queued' threshold.

retro_slice.description: How many not-yet-audited verified/shipped tasks each summit re-examines (oldest-by-ID first). Capped at 20 so a misconfigured roster can't make every summit re-audit the whole archive.

track.description: Optional **Track:** scope for trigger counting, retrospective candidates, and synthesized tasks. Empty = all tracks.

personas.description: Max 10 — each persona is a parallel agent per summit; an unbounded roster is an unbounded cost knob.

prompt.description: The persona's role description, used verbatim as its agent-panel prompt. Trusted project configuration (see the top-level trust-model note), capped at 2000 chars to bound per-summit prompt cost.
